recognize_zh: 腹水抹片中一個大型圓形細胞團，中央為淡染、含細點狀物質的巨大空泡，周邊有三個深染、被壓扁的新月形細胞核，像印戒一樣環繞，屬於轉移性癌伴印戒細胞分化的典型線索。
features: Large rounded cell cluster with a central, voluminous pale vacuole containing faint granular/mucoid material
Three dense crescent- to oval-shaped hyperchromatic nuclei displaced to the periphery
Thin rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm encircling the vacuole
Size markedly larger than the adjacent small cell/red cell ghost
Paucicellular clean background; soft focus limits chromatin and nucleolar detail
describe_en: Ascitic fluid smear shows a large, rounded cluster with a central voluminous pale vacuole containing faint mucoid material, around which three hyperchromatic, crescentic nuclei are compressed at the periphery within a thin rim of basophilic cytoplasm. The configuration recapitulates signet-ring morphology, either as a multinucleated cell or as a tight cluster of cells sharing a mucin vacuole. The background is paucicellular, and nuclear detail is limited by focus. Findings are suggestive of metastatic carcinoma with signet-ring cell differentiation; confirmation by cell block with mucin stains and epithelial immunohistochemistry is recommended.

ddx.dx: Reactive mesothelial cells with degenerative vacuolation
ddx.vs: Mesothelial cells show central nuclei, peripheral lacy skirt and multiple small vacuoles, and are calretinin/WT1-positive and mucin-negative.
Macrophages have single bland reniform nuclei and multiple small foamy vacuoles, CD68-positive, rather than crescentic nuclei compressed by one large vacuole.
Mesothelioma forms three-dimensional morules with cell windows and is calretinin/WT1/D2-40-positive and mucin-negative, unlike a signet-ring adenocarcinoma.
